input.rationale:
Searches for "indemnif", "hold harmless", "defend" and "infringe" return nothing, and a full read of the Warranties (Section 9) and General Provisions (Section 10) sections confirms the Agreement contains no indemnity, defence or hold-harmless obligation in either direction — HDI gives no IP infringement indemnity for the Site/Services it builds and hosts, which is walk-away territory under the rule (the mutual advertising covenant in Section 7.2 and the confidentiality obligations do not carry any indemnity). We therefore inserted the vendor-side indemnity as new Section 9(c) covering third-party IP claims, HDI's breach of law, HDI-caused unauthorised disclosure of Company data/Content, and HDI's gross negligence or wilful misconduct, with standard notice/control/cooperation mechanics and a carve-out for Company-supplied Content and Marks; we did not add any Company indemnity.</parationale>
<parameter name="confidence">0.9

proposal.summary: Insert HDI indemnity (IP infringement, breach of law, data/Content security incidents, gross negligence/wilful misconduct) as new Section 9(c)
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement contains no indemnity in either direction, so we have added an HDI indemnity covering third-party IP claims relating to the Site and Services plus HDI's breach of law, unauthorised disclosure of Company data and Content, and gross negligence or wilful misconduct, with standard notice, control and cooperation mechanics. Our playbook requires the service provider to stand behind third-party claims arising from the services it builds and hosts; we can discuss usual exclusions for Company-supplied Content and Marks if helpful.

ops.text: (c) Indemnification by HDI. HDI shall defend, indemnify and hold harmless the Company and its affiliates from and against any third-party claim, and all resulting damages, losses, costs and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees), to the extent arising out of (1) an allegation that the Site, the Services or any materials or technology provided by HDI infringe or misappropriate any intellectual property right (other than to the extent the allegation arises from Content or Marks supplied by the Company); (2) HDI's breach of applicable law; (3) any unauthorized access to or disclosure of Content, user information or other Company data caused by HDI; or (4) HDI's gross negligence or wilful misconduct. The Company shall give HDI prompt written notice of the claim, HDI shall have control of the defense and settlement (provided that no settlement imposing any obligation or admission on the Company shall be made without the Company's prior written consent), and the Company shall provide reasonable cooperation at HDI's expense.
